name: Wakaze
about: Wakaze makes sake in France. Takuma Inagawa founded the company in Japan in 2016 with Shoya Imai, and in 2019 it opened Kura Grand Paris, a brewery on the outskirts of Paris.
It brews with rice from the Camargue in southern France, and its motto is Mastered in Japan, Made in France. Its releases include flavoured sakes and sakes matured in whisky barrels.
